title: API Example Linter
user: API maintainers who need documentation examples to remain executable and representative as schemas and generated clients change.
smallest_useful_product: CLI extracts JSON/curl examples from Markdown/OpenAPI, validates them against a chosen operation/schema, optionally runs safe mock checks, and posts line-level CI annotations.
constraints: Never execute arbitrary shell in curl blocks; mock mode by default; support versioned OpenAPI documents.
